tasks.title: Implement v2 operator instruction: image import (both sides), live staged Auto Match + observable processing log, fix delete-effect crash, fix dead controls, fix Auto Match brightness math, reset session on new import
tasks.notes: All six operator points addressed: (1) IMAGE IMPORT — MainActivity picker now launches [video/*, image/*]; image/* is decoded via new media/ImageLoader (bounds pass + inSampleSize, max 4096px, heap-safe) into new media/MediaSource (Video|Image); reference AND target accept either in any combination; FramePick/TargetFrame/Preview screens branch per source type. (2) LIVE LOG + VISIBLE AUTO MODE — MatchSession gained an observable SnapshotStateList processing log (logLine(), capped 200); imports, frame matching (FrameMatcher.findMatch onLog: coarse-scan count + best distance, verification, best match + confidence) and Auto Match all stream into a Processing-log LogCard on the editor and matching screens (auto-follow LazyColumn). Auto Match is now STAGED: samples pixels, then per channel (Red -> Green -> Blue) computes the correction, logs black/white point + gamma numbers, shows a live staged preview bitmap of the target still with the partial per-channel LUTs applied, and only then commits the AutoMatch effect — the user watches each channel adjust before output. (3) DELETE CRASH — root cause: stack was a plain mutableListOf while renderPreview iterated it on Dispatchers.Default; deletion from the UI thread raced the render -> ConcurrentModificationException. Fix: stack is now SnapshotStateList (snapshot-isolated iteration) and applyTo() iterates a detached snapshot (enabledEffects()); delete button now also exists on Auto Match. (4) DEAD CONTROLS — root cause: MatchSession.revision was a plain Int, so Compose never observed mutations; sliders/curves/levels changed the model but nothing recomposed or re-rendered. Fix: revision is now mutableIntStateOf-backed and read at the top of EditorScreen (every touch() recomposes + re-renders), and CurvesEditor's Canvas draw lambda reads session.revision so the graph redraws during drag. Also replaced the confusing 'edit last-of-type' binding with tap-to-select effect cards. (5) BRIGHT/UGLY AUTO MODE — root cause in ColorMath.channelCurve: gamma was derived from (outMed - linMed)/255 (goes negative when the reference is darker -> clamped garbage) and then double-inverted. Fixed to the AE-exact exponent k satisfying (linMed/255)^k = outMed/255, i.e. k = ln(outMed/255)/ln(linMed/255), applied as pow(t, k) with reported AE gamma = 1/k; verified numerically (median maps exactly: 126.7->140.0, 140->126.7, 100->160.0); degenerate flat channels now fall back to identity instead of blowing up. (6) STALE SETTINGS — session.reset() (clears stack/frames/crop/log/precision) runs on EVERY new media import and on the new 'Start new project' button (which also releases both sources and returns Home), so leaving the page and importing new resources can never resurrect previous settings. App-only change: nothing touched in engine/ (no Engine-level fix was required).

notes: Substitution entries: (1) frame matching uses a luminance-structure descriptor instead of OpenCV keypoints — heavyweight native CV would violate lightweight-by-default for a 96px structural match (carried from v1). No new substitutions in v2. Engine helpers used: SafeSave (SAF ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT export — no DownloadManager), ScreenSecurity (FLAG_SECURE per-screen on frame/editor/matching/preview screens). Permissions model: SAF only (OpenDocument/CreateDocument); zero manifest permissions — image import needed none. New deps in v2: NONE (image decode is android.graphics.BitmapFactory; live state is androidx.compose.runtime which was already present). Not Engine-level: all changes are app-local; engine/ untouched because none of the six fixes concern the shared component/theme library.
